title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Kenyan Kissed Red Sauce
description: A flavorful and healthy fish dish cooked with a spicy Kenyan kissed red sauce. This recipe combines the delicate taste of snapper with a bold and aromatic sauce.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the snapper fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer the skillet to the oven.
Bake the snapper for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine the diced red peppers, onion, and garlic in a bowl.
Stir in the lemon juice and set aside.
To serve, place a snapper fillet on each plate and spoon the Kenyan kissed red sauce over the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
